description:
Convert an external product identifier (UPC, EAN, GTIN, ISBN, JAN, MINSAN) into the corresponding Amazon ASIN, with an essential product snapshot. This is the bridge between manufacturer/retail barcodes and the Amazon ecosystem.

Use this tool when the user has a barcode or standard product code and wants to find the matching Amazon listing. Typical workflows: catalog matching, inventory synchronization, converting supplier data into Amazon ASINs. Also accepts ASIN as input type if you need to validate one.

You MUST set identifier_type to match the code you have. Guessing the wrong type returns no results. UPC is 12 digits, EAN/GTIN is 13, ISBN is 10 or 13 (books). If the user gives a keyword instead of a code, use search_products instead. Costs 1 credit.

domain.description: Amazon marketplace domain extension. Determines the regional Amazon site the data is fetched from. Use the domain that matches the user's market, because prices, availability and rankings differ across marketplaces.

identifier.description: The product code value (e.g. '724382975021' for a UPC). Digits only for barcode types.

identifier_type.description: The type of code provided. UPC: 12-digit US barcode. EAN/GTIN: 13-digit international barcode. ISBN: book identifier. JAN: Japanese barcode. MINSAN: Italian pharma code. ASIN: Amazon's own identifier.

name: lookup_product

credits_remaining.description: Credits left on the account after this request.

data.description: Parsed Amazon data for the operation.

operation.description: Easyparser operation that ran, e.g. DETAIL or OFFER.

request_id.description: Easyparser request ID, useful for support and error logs.
